subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences which are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It also wants to know how many students have been provided nutritious food and improved their overall health.

B. The Midday Meal Scheme, that aims to provide free food to children, is in focus again.

C. About 1.3 million government schools are covered under this welfare program of children.

D. The Government now wants to take stock of the implementation of the program.
solution:
The correct answer is** "BCDA"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage talks about the "midday meal scheme".
 
• The first sentence will be **sentence B** as it tells that the Midday meal scheme.
 
• The second sentence will be **sentence C** as it further tells about the Midday meal scheme and how many schools are covered under this scheme.
 
• The third sentence will be **sentence D** as it tells what the government is doing.
 
• The fourth sentence will be **sentence A** what the government wants to know after the implementation of the program.

 

**So the correct sequence is-** ***B.** The Midday Meal Scheme, that aims to provide free food to children, is in focus again. **C. **About 1.3 million government schools are covered under this welfare program of children. **D. **The Government now wants to take stock of the implementation of the program.** A. **It also wants to know how many students have been provided nutritious food and improved their overall health.*
